rpx

Why does the same button size look wider on another phone?

A relative size unit converted according to a mini program page’s width·When page width is 375px, 600rpx is 300px; at 450px it is 360px. Both occupy 80% of page width. Relative sizing does not automatically reflow columns or prevent long text from overflowing.
Know first
WXSSResponsive Design
responsive pixel
How wide is 600rpx on two page widths?
Button size conversionwidth: 600rpx
Page 375px = 750rpx
300px
Share of page width80%
600 ÷ 750 × 375 = 300px

750rpx corresponds to full page width, so 600rpx takes 80%. The diagram encodes that proportion.

How is the size calculated?

Page width is the reference: Displayed CSS pixels = rpx value × page width in CSS pixels ÷ 750. The reference is page width, not physical pixel density.

Keep content readable: Scaling margins and widths can help. Long labels and columns still need wrapping and layout decisions at actual device widths.

Does replacing every px with rpx make the layout fit?

Replacing every px value with rpx does not guarantee a good layout. Text size, touch areas, and wider screens require checking separately.
